One person can create more than ever before.

Every generation of technology lowered a different barrier.
AI is lowering one we’ve lived with for centuries.

Before machines · 1661–1662

Skill was the bottleneck.

To make something, you first had to master the craft.

1913 · Industrialization

Machines multiplied what we could produce.

Machines brought speed and scale. Specialized work still required specialized skills.

1984 · Personal computing

Computers put hundreds of tools on one desk.

Writing, designing, calculating, editing, and building became accessible through software.

But you still had to learn each tool.

Now · AI

The tool is no longer
the limit.

Move between code, design, research, 3D, video, and writing. Start creating while you learn the tools.
